finding: The P2E05 semantic-successor gate proves exact P2E05 source blobs and semantic replays, but additionally computes its historical allowed-file delta from P2E05_BASE to current HEAD. That makes every later unrelated canonical successor appear to be an out-of-scope P2E05 mutation. The failure is therefore a historical-scope binding defect in the preservation gate, not a P2E06 scientific or production regression.

bounded_correction.rule: Validate the P2E05 allowed-file delta only over the immutable historical interval P2E05_BASE...P2E05_QUALIFIED_HEAD, require that qualified head to remain an ancestor of current HEAD, then continue exact current-HEAD blob locks and semantic replays. Do not whitelist P2E06 files as P2E05 scope.

excluded: no wildcard exception for future source mutations
